data.name: Naphtiel
data.long_meaning: The name Naphtali comes from the Hebrew roots naphtal, meaning 'my struggle', and el, meaning 'God'. Therefore, the name Naphtali can be interpreted as 'God's revelation through my struggle'. This name is mentioned in the Old Testament as the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel and as the name of a son of Jacob.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes God's presence and guidance during difficult times.
data.numerology_meaning: A creative and loving person with a strong sense of responsibility

in_greek.name: Ναφθαλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Νάφθαλ (Νάφθαλ) είναι όνομα που συνδέεται με την Παλαιστίνη. Το όνομα σημαίνει 'υιος-Ναφθαλ' (υιος-Ναφθαλ 'παιδί του Ναφθαλ' ). Στον Καινή Διαθήκη, ο Νάφθαλ (Νάφθαλ) ήταν γιος του Ιαΐρ (Ιαΐρ) (Λουκάς 3:26).

in_latin.name: Naphtali
in_latin.long_meaning: Naphtali est nomen quod connectivum est cum terra Israel. Nomen significat 'filius-Naphtali' (filius-Naphtali 'filium Naphtali' ). Secundum Bibliam, Naphtali erat filius Iair (Iair) (Lucas 3:26).

in_english.long_meaning: Naphtiel is a Christian name with roots from Hebrew, meaning 'son of Naphtali', which symbolizes 'branch of God'. In the Bible, Naphtali was a son of Jacob (Genesis 30:8). The name is associated with the tribe of Naphtali, one of the twelve tribes of Israel. In Christian tradition, Naphtiel is considered a strong and spiritual name, representing growth and development. It is also associated with the qualities of faith, hope, and charity.

In Jewish tradition, Naphtali is one of the twelve tribes of Israel, and its members were believed to have a strong warrior spirit. In Christian tradition, Naphtali is mentioned as the name of a son of Jacob and the brother of Joseph, who was a prominent figure in the early Christian story of the Joseph auction and sale into Egypt.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Naphtali carries a deep spiritual significance as it reminds us of the importance of facing our struggles and difficulties with faith in God. The name suggests that even in our struggles, we can find divine revelation and guidance if we surrender ourselves to God. Naphtali's name is a reminder that God is with us in our toughest battles and that He can bring good out of even the most challenging circumstances. Therefore, the name Naphtali is an inspiring name for those who seek to follow God through their struggles and challenges in life.
